module: Decal texture browser of the Dynamic Decals tool (interface). Adds the "Textures" (order 10) and "Tags" (order 20) tabs to the browser, an inspector for the selection `editor.selection["dynamicDecalTexture"]` (editing of the sidecar file's metadata/tags), multiple selection (Shift = range, Ctrl = add), a context menu to assign a texture to a property and a notification when missing metadata files have been created. The file logic is in editor_api_dynamicDecals_textures.
notes: Files whose name starts with "_" are excluded from the list.
Preferences `dynamicDecalsTool.textureBrowser`: loadImagesPerFrameCount (int 3), enableVirtualScrolling (bool true: only visible textures are loaded), texturePreviewSize (float 128, from 32 to 512).
setup creates the textures folder (FS:directoryCreate) and calls the API's textures.setup().
The same notification block is duplicated in setup and in onTextureFileAdded.
onTextureFileDeleted modifies the list during ipairs; harmless for a single deleted file.

getTexturesDirectoryPath.desc: Returns the decal textures folder (delegates to editor_api_dynamicDecals_textures).

dynamicDecals_onTextureFileAdded.desc: Hook called when a texture file is added to the watched folder: if missing metadata files were created, adds a notification with selection buttons.

filepath.desc: Path of the added file (not used directly).

dynamicDecals_onTextureFileDeleted.desc: Hook called when a texture file is deleted: removes it from the `dynamicDecalTexture` selection (which becomes nil if empty).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the related modules, registers the Textures and Tags tabs, the "Browser / Textures" doc page and the inspector of the dynamicDecalTexture type, creates the textures folder, initializes the textures API and notifies about missing metadata files.
